description.value: You are descended from hardors who were once entrusted with the sacred task of scouting ahead to find sources of fresh water. These unforgiving journeys required dogged persistence and incredible fortitude. Though that specialty has faded into the past, the skills and hardiness it required have not. You're trained in Survival. If you would automatically become trained in Survival (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice. You can Hustle twice as long while exploring before you have to stop. Your strength and energy serve to bolster your allies as well. If you're in a group that is Hustling, you increase the total number of minutes the group can Hustle by 10 minutes, or by 20 minutes if you're 13th level or higher. You gain the Terrain Expertise feat for desert terrain.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
